releases.name: Collider Visualizer v0.1.2
releases.body:
* Added Hotkey for enabling
* Added the last shapes renderers
* Fixed cone and sphere renders
* Added layer filtering for Volume shapes
See updated readme for info on the new settings.
releases.bodyZh:
* 添加了启用热键
* 添加了最后形状的渲染器
* 修复了锥体和球体的渲染
* 为体积形状添加了层过滤
请查看更新后的readme以获取有关新设置的说明。

releases.name: Collider Visualizer v0.1.1
releases.body:
* Added Shape visualization (WIP)
    * Shape Bounds - Magenta
    * Detector Shapes - White
    * Volume Shapes - Cyan
 
Shapes that use the cone or the cylinder format are a little broken, and box, hemisphere and hemicapsule aren't yet rendered.

Thanks Xen for the idea!
releases.bodyZh:
* 添加了形状可视化（进行中）
    * 形状边界 - 紫色
    * 检测器形状 - 白色
    * 体积形状 - 青色

使用锥形或圆柱形格式的形状有点损坏，而立方体、半球和半球帽尚未渲染。

感谢 Xen 的想法！

releases.name: Collider Visualizer v0.1.0
releases.body:
### First Release!

Some known issues:

* The visualization of capsule colliders are quite broken, with the capsule being rotated compared to the actual capsule
* Some colliders don't seem to appear (like the ones from the geysers in TH) but this issue might be related to the first one
releases.bodyZh:
### 首次发布！

已知问题：

* 胶囊碰撞器的可视化效果相当破败，胶囊的旋转与实际胶囊不一致
* 一些碰撞器似乎没有出现（例如 TH 中的间歇泉碰撞器），但这个问题可能与第一个问题有关
